importantFindings.title: A column label with a singular staff word at the top of the sheet still marks nothing when a student heading follows. Role-less staff rows between the label and 'Allievi', 'Iscritti' or 'Corsisti' are READY with no mark, and 5c1e029 dropped them. This is the top half of F1R8-2's own scenario
importantFindings.location: src/capabilities/studentScan.ts:1210-1214 (the label branch does not consult studentHeadingFollows), 979-985, 1197-1202; .evidence/F1/self-review.json:154
importantFindings.scenario: Probes round9/r8a (rerun) and r9a group G, text and laid-out TSV (r9b), fake date 2026-09-27, course start 2026-08-29. Take a label, then 'Verdani Luca 03/04/1990 36 anni' and 'Galli Sara 05/05/1995 31 anni', then 'Allievi', 'Iscritti' or 'Corsisti', then the students. The labels tested were 'Nome assistente:', 'Firma assistente', 'Firma istruttrice', 'Nome volontario', 'Cognome Nome Nascita Assistente', 'Note assistente', 'Data firma istruttrice' and 'Assistente: Neri Firma', each alone or under the title 'Corso Deriva 2'. Verdani and Galli come out 'none|READY'. 5c1e029 dropped both, because assistente, istruttrice and volontario started its staff section, and it read the students after the heading correctly. The same happens with ages only ('Verdani Luca 36 anni') and on a laid-out table. A label split from its name by OCR does the same: 'Nome assistente:' then 'Galli Sara 05/05/1995' then 'Allievi' gives Galli READY. The r8a rerun has 32 problems, all of this one kind; the round-8 foot and mid positions are fixed. The literal outcome is the blocker class (a staff row READY with no mark that was not ready at 5c1e029). It is rated important because round 8 rated the same scenario important, and its suggested fix explicitly kept column headers skipped alone at the top. The precondition is also narrow: staff printed without a role code but with a birth date or age, under a singular-word label, above a student heading. Next steps describes the rule accurately ('marks them only after a row that reads as a student') but does not say that such staff rows are left ready. The telephone branch already uses the right signal, studentHeadingFollows.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: In the label branch, also arm the marking when studentHeadingFollows[index], as the telephone and age branch does. A header directly above the students with no later student heading still marks nothing. To keep a footer from arming it, see F1R9-3. Add a test: 'Nome assistente:', a staff row with a date, 'Allievi', students, where the staff row is possible-staff and the students are unmarked. Change F1R8-2's disposition to say that the top variant is covered.

qolFindings.title: A staff line whose staff word is not its first word, carrying an age but no date, is itself READY with no mark at the top of the sheet when it reads as two name words. 5c1e029 dropped it
qolFindings.scenario: Probe r9a group D. In 'Neri volontario 30 anni', 'Rossi segreteria 45 anni', 'De Rossi volontario 30 anni' and 'Personale Rossa 36 anni', the staff word is not a PERSONNEL_ROW_PREFIX. Such a line as the first line, followed by students with no student heading, gives the line itself as 'none|READY' (for example 'Neri|volontario|30'). 5c1e029 dropped it together with every student after it, and reported the sheet UNSUITABLE. With a given name ('Verdani Luisa assistente 36 anni') the name has 3 words and needs review. Below a student, or with a date, it is marked. The realism is low: a staff row with no given name and the role written after the surname.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: When a line matches PERSONNEL_SECTION_PATTERN and still becomes a candidate, give that candidate possible-staff whatever its position. It is at most one extra tap, and a contact line is never ready anyway. Add a test.

qolFindings.title: Iscritti, Corsisti and Partecipanti count as a student heading anywhere in any line, so footers and mixed staff headings mislead the marking
qolFindings.scenario: Probes r9a groups B and C, and r9b. (a) Noise: 'Segreteria 0789 123456' at the top, the students, then the footer 'Totale iscritti: 3' or 'Numero partecipanti: 2'. Every student is marked possible-staff, because studentHeadingFollows sees the footer. 5c1e029 reported the sheet UNSUITABLE. SC-11 says 'the school's contact line … mark nothing', which fails on such a sheet. (b) New READY staff: students, 'Personale', a staff row, then 'Totale iscritti: 4', 'Elenco iscritti - pag. 2', 'Iscritti al turno: 4' or 'N. corsisti 4', then a second staff row. The second staff row is READY with no mark. The same holds for every staff row under a mixed heading such as 'Volontari iscritti' or 'Personale e iscritti', because the student word wins and ends the marking. 5c1e029 dropped these rows. Neither case is described in next steps, which says a student heading ends the marking.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Treat as a student heading only a short line with no digits and no staff word. Let a staff word win on a mixed line, or describe this in next steps. Add tests for 'Totale iscritti: 3' below a contact line and for 'Volontari iscritti'.

qolFindings.title: A row whose name cell holds 'iscritti' or 'corsisti' is now dropped silently. 5c1e029 kept it
qolFindings.scenario: Probe r9a group F. 'Corsisti Marco 12/03/2014 12 anni' and 'Rossi Maria iscritti 12/03/2014 12 anni', at the top or between students, vanish with no notice. 5c1e029 read the first READY and the second for review. No real surname is known to match, so this is speculative. The same pre-existing mechanism drops 'Rossi Maria Allieva 12/03/2014 12 anni' at both commits (a per-row role column printing Allievo or Allieva); that case is identical and unlisted.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Apply the student-heading 'continue' only to lines with no date or age that could be a birth date. Headings with a course date, such as '15/06/2026 Pagina Iscritti 1', are still dropped by classifyLine.
